_fixture: Recording/history family fixture. Hand-authored prototype data: byte rates, sizes, segment boundaries, marker times, writer errors, finalization and recovery states are invented. No recorder, encoder, journal or file system exists. Shared scenario values (elapsed, bytes, free space, segment count) come from fixtures/sessions.json; this file only adds what the recording screens need beyond them.
